task: Render Submitted Capstone Documents with Genuine Document Format (.docx OOXML and .pdf Vector Canvas) across Plagiarism Checker and Submissions

root_cause_analysis.issue: When users submitted documents on /plagiarism-checker, the report dumped an unformatted monospace string without margins, page boundaries, or centered headings. This violated institutional presentation expectations and the Mandatory Unified Sophisticated Document Reader Contract.
culprits: ArchivePlagiarismCheckerPage.jsx previously imported components/plagiarism/PlagiarismReportPage.jsx which rendered an obsolete <AnnotatedText> dumping raw text without Word/PDF format.
SophisticatedDocumentViewer did not support direct File/Blob objects uploaded in the browser without database submission records.
PlagiarismReportPage defaulted canvasMode to 'extracted' whenever reportData was present, preventing the genuine document view from loading by default.
components/plagiarism/PlagiarismReportPage.jsx was a 501-line legacy duplicate component with hardcoded monospace text rendering.

modifications.summary: Added direct file/blob support to DocxPreviewRenderer and PDF viewer, relaxed submission guard, and polished responsive header toolbar to avoid badge crowding.
Wired effectiveFile and fileName props, defaulted canvasMode to 'document' when binary document or file is available, and connected file={effectiveFile} to SophisticatedDocumentViewer.
Replaced legacy component import with canonical pages/submissions/PlagiarismReportPage, passing file={file}, reportData={reportData}, and initialCanvasMode='document'.
Refactored to forwarding facade delegating directly to canonical pages/submissions/PlagiarismReportPage, removing the legacy unformatted text renderer.

playwright_visual_audit.visual_check: Verified 1:1 match with Reference Image 2: centered bold title, byline, authors, authentic page boundaries, margins, and typography.
